requirements: R1: Add a docker-compose.yml at the repository root to start the full stack
R2: Expose a health-check endpoint for launch verification

slices.title: Add docker-compose and health-check endpoint
slices.jtbd: When implementing containerization for this epic, I want to add a docker-compose.yml and a health-check endpoint, so that the full stack can be started and verified locally
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the repository root, When I run docker-compose up, Then the full stack starts successfully.
Given the running stack, When I ping the health-check endpoint, Then it returns a 200 OK status.
Given the test suite, When automated E2E and integration tests execute, Then the docker-compose setup and health-check endpoint are explicitly verified.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce full stack startup time to under 1 minute

requirements: R1: Add an update action to the UI that invokes the PUT endpoint
R2: Add a delete action to the UI that invokes the DELETE endpoint

slices.title: Patch UI for updating and deleting materials
slices.jtbd: When implementing the update and delete UI for this epic, I want to add edit and delete actions to the existing material view, so that the knowledge base accurately reflects current protocols
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material in the UI, When the user edits and saves, Then a PUT request is sent and the view updates.
Given an existing material in the UI, When the user deletes it, Then a DELETE request is sent and it is removed from the view.
Given the frontend test suite, When component logic (unit) and UI workflows (E2E) are tested, Then the update and delete actions are verified to function correctly.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce material deprecation time to instant

epics.title: Authentication and Authorization Mechanism
epics.jtbd: When accessing the knowledge base, I want to authenticate my identity, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access or modification.
requirements: R1: Protect API endpoints with standard authentication
R2: Block unauthenticated access and redirect users to log in

slices.title: Implement authentication patch for API and UI
slices.jtbd: When implementing authentication for this epic, I want to enforce standard session protection on API endpoints and UI, so that restricted data is protected from unauthorized access
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated request to the API, When the request is received, Then it is blocked with a 401 status.
Given an unauthenticated user on the frontend, When they attempt to access restricted views, Then they are prompted to log in.
Given the test suite, When pure logic (unit), API flows (integration), and login journeys (E2E) execute, Then authentication enforcement is verified across all layers.
